desc: Define the four diagonal direction vectors and the mapping from each direction to its clockwise 90-degree diagonal direction.
Build alternating directional suffix DP tables for expected values `0` and `2`.
Perform directional scans maintaining valid incoming first-arm prefixes and combine each pivot with its clockwise-turn suffix.
Implement `lenOfVDiagonal` in O(nm) time and memory.
Validate against all examples and edge cases: single `1`, no `1`, straight-only segments, immediate turns, and boundaries.
